run_character_gen: run the character_gen SGL function to generate Harry Potter character JSON in Chinese constrained by regex
create_character_regex: create a regex pattern that constrains LLM output to valid Chinese Harry Potter character JSON with nested wand object
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to initialize a SGLang RuntimeEndpoint and execute character generation for a named character
test_sgl_gen_regex: test the sgl.gen API with a regex parameter to enforce structured JSON output from the LLM
build_sglang_backend: build a SGLang RuntimeEndpoint backend connection and set it as the default backend for SGL function execution
